journals.title: British Journal of Sports Medicine
journals.source_note: Live BJSM guide at https://bjsm.bmj.com/pages/authors/ was bot-blocked (HTTP 403); web.archive.org and archive.ph were both unreachable from this tool (no archive snapshot could be fetched). BJSM-specific values (article-type word limits, abstract word limit, exact abstract section labels, declaration order) are UNVERIFIED and left null. Formatting, reference and figure values were encoded from the authoritative cross-journal BMJ author hub https://authors.bmj.com/writing-and-formatting/formatting-your-paper/ (BMJ house style applies to all BMJ journals including BJSM); publisher and ISSN from Wikipedia; citation style cross-checked at Paperpile. Route to needs-headless-recheck.
schema_gaps: Figures: BMJ requires min 300 dpi for non-vector images and 1200 dpi for line art — SCHEMA GAP: schema holds a single min_dpi (encoded 300, the general minimum); line-art 1200 dpi not representable.

journals.title: Journal of Sport and Health Science
journals.publisher: Elsevier B.V. (co-published with KeAi Communications; owned by Shanghai University of Sport)
journals.source_note: Live ScienceDirect/Elsevier guide-for-authors returned HTTP 403 (bot-blocked); web.archive.org was unreachable from this environment and reader proxies (r.jina.ai) were auth-gated, so no usable snapshot URL could be obtained. Values were encoded from WebSearch-surfaced verbatim guide quotes plus the journal's official EndNote reference-style page (https://endnote.com/downloads/styles/journal-of-sport-and-health-science/). Live guide URL bot-blocked: https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-sport-and-health-science/publish/guide-for-authors
schema_gaps: Commentary cap (not in article_types): <=1000 words, 1 display item, <=20 references. Opinion cap (not in article_types): 1500-2500 words, <=25 references. Captured here since they cannot be word_limits keys.
original_research display-item rule is a COMBINED cap: 'no more than 6 display items (tables and/or figures)'. Schema has separate figures_max/tables_max so both left null; do not enforce 6 per type.

journals.title: Journal of Cachexia, Sarcopenia and Muscle
journals.publisher: Wiley (Wiley-Blackwell), in association with the Society on Sarcopenia, Cachexia and Wasting Disorders
journals.source_note: Live Wiley Author Guidelines page (https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/1353921906009/homepage/forauthors.html) was bot-blocked (HTTP 403 Forbidden); web.archive.org was unreachable via the fetch tool. Values encoded from WebSearch extraction of the same Wiley guide plus citation-style databases (Paperpile/Citationsy). No archive snapshot could be loaded. blocked.
schema_gaps: SCHEMA GAP: guide states Original Articles 'may include up to 8 figures ... and/or tables' — this reads as a COMBINED cap of 8 figures-and/or-tables, not 8 of each. Schema has no combined cap, so figures_max=8 and tables_max=8 each encode the same ceiling; a figures+tables sum >8 will not be caught.
Original Article figures also limited to 'max of 6 sub-sections per figure' — no schema slot for sub-panel limit.

journals.title: Osteoarthritis and Cartilage
journals.publisher: Elsevier (official journal of the Osteoarthritis Research Society International, OARSI)
journals.source_note: Live ScienceDirect page 403-blocked to plain WebFetch; encoded from a headless-browser render of the LIVE canonical URL (Apify rag-web-browser), which returned the full guide text (not a shell/CAPTCHA). Note contains 'blocked' and 'headless' to route the freshness cron to a headless re-fetch.
schema_gaps: SCHEMA GAP - combined figure+table caps: full-length original research = 'no more than 4000 words, 8 figures and tables, and 50 references'; reviews = 'max 8 tables and/or figures, 100 references'; brief report = '2 figures and/or tables'; editorial/commentary = 'max 2 figures and/or tables'. These are COMBINED figure+table limits; figures_max/tables_max left null (per-type) to avoid implying separate caps. Full-length & reviews combined cap = 8; editorial combined cap = 2.

journals.title: Journal of Bone and Mineral Research
journals.source_note: [main-session: live fetch was bot-blocked/shell at finalize; hash is of a <=12mo Wayback archive snapshot: https://web.archive.org/web/20260306130252id_/https://academic.oup.com/jbmr/pages/general-instructions]
schema_gaps: SCHEMA GAP — display items: most types allow a COMBINED max of 8 display items (tables + figures), which the per-type figures_max/tables_max split cannot represent; both left null. Complex Clinical Challenges is 'usually 2 (1 table + 1 figure), max 3'.
SCHEMA GAP — tiered figure DPI: color halftones 300dpi, grayscale halftones 600dpi, combination/line-art 600-900dpi, monochrome line art 1200dpi. min_dpi encodes the 300 floor only.

SCHEMA GAP — Lay Summary is required for most types (max 100 words for Research/Invited Review/Systematic Review; max 200 for Clinical Trial/Perspective). No schema field exists; not encoded. highlights_required set false (no 'Highlights' feature; lay summary is separate).

schema_gaps: Declarations (all required under a 'Declarations' heading, 'Not applicable' if irrelevant): Ethics approval and consent to participate, Consent for publication, Availability of data and materials, Competing interests, Funding, Authors' contributions, Acknowledgements, Authors' information (optional). Letters to the Editor: <=500-word body, no abstract, must begin with 'To the Editor'. Not encoded (no schema field): APC (GBP 2990 / USD 4390 / EUR 3390) and licence options CC BY-NC-ND or CC BY.

journals.title: Knee Surgery, Sports Traumatology, Arthroscopy
journals.publisher: Wiley (on behalf of ESSKA — European Society of Sports Traumatology, Knee Surgery and Arthroscopy)
journals.source_note: Publisher migrated from Springer to Wiley/ESSKA; the old Springer guide (link.springer.com/journal/167) was NOT used. Live Wiley page is Cloudflare-protected: WebFetch returned 403 and the browser hit a 'Just a moment...' Cloudflare interstitial. Encoded from the LIVE page read via a headless browser after the Cloudflare challenge cleared: https://esskajournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/hub/journal/14337347/homepage/author-guidelines . Freshness cron needs headless fetch for this domain (Cloudflare).
schema_gaps: SCHEMA GAP — tiered figure DPI: guide specifies Line Art min 1200 dpi, Halftone (photographs) min 300 dpi, Combination art min 600 dpi. min_dpi encoded as 300 (the halftone floor, most relevant to orthopedic radiographs/MRI); the 1200/600 tiers cannot be represented.

Title page also required to contain a list of abbreviations, author contribution statements, and a consent statement — none have a clean title_page.elements enum slot; abbreviations has no schema home at all.

journals.title: Journal of Orthopaedic Translation
journals.source_note: Live ScienceDirect guide bot-blocked (HTTP 403); encoded from Wayback archive snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20240304234847/https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-orthopaedic-translation/publish/guide-for-authors dated 2024-03-04. This is the only 200-status Wayback snapshot of the page; it is >12 months old (no newer snapshot exists). e-ISSN 2214-0328.
schema_gaps: COMBINED figure+table caps that the schema (separate figures_max/tables_max) can't hold, so left null: original_research <=8 figures/tables total; review <=4; letter <=2; perspectives 1-2. Guide: 'not more than 8 figures/tables' etc. Also 'no limit on the number of pages, figures, or colour figures' stated for print, but per-type caps above govern manuscript body.
Figure DPI is TIERED (schema holds one int; set to the 300 floor): halftones/photographs >=300 dpi; bitmapped line drawings >=1000 dpi; combination line/halftone >=500 dpi.
